newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Lai Sun Dev year net rises 5.26 percent.
newsitem.headline: Lai Sun Dev year net rises 5.26 percent.

text.p: Company name Lai Sun Development Co Ltd
NOTE - Lai Sun Development, a 50.11 percent owned subsidiary of Lai Sun Garment (International) Ltd, is engaged in investment holding and property development.
The exceptional items represent expenses incurred in connection with the issue of US$120 million guaranteed bonds by a wholly-owned subsidiary during the year.

The accounting policy for hotel properties whereby such assets were stated at cost and the building portion was depreciated at 2.5 percent per annum on the straight-line basis in prior years was changed during the year ended July 31, 1996.

Directors consider that the new policy, whereby such assets are now carried at historical cost and not depreciated, is consistent with industry practice and will give a fairer presentation of the results and the financial position of the group.

In restating the financial statements for 1995, the net profit for that year has been increased by HK$9.57 million. Accordingly, the carrying value of hotel properties as at August 1, 1994, was increased by HK$37.39 million and the group's share and minority interests' share of retained earnings have been increased by HK$20.81 million and HK$16.58 million, respectively.
Comparative figures have been reclassified to conform with current year presentation.

The final dividend per share has been calculated taking into account a five-into-one share consolidation effective September 6, 1996, which took place after the final dividend for the year ended July 31, 1995, was declared.
